entries.behavior: Initialize and execute a conversational turn through the AIAgent facade and conversation loop.
observed: TurnFacadeMixin.run_conversation delegates to agent.conversation_loop.run_conversation. The inner turn resets per-turn compression flags and applies fast-mode state before inference.

entries.behavior: Bound compression work with progress-aware timeout and fence durable commit admission at cancellation.
observed: CompressionFacadeMixin._compress_context registers a fence for the active attempt. A hard stop can prevent a new commit from starting. If a commit was already admitted, cancellation waits for it to finish.

entries.behavior: Read per-message persisted markers to skip duplicate flushes and stamp messages after database writes.
observed: _db_flush_collect skips durable messages. _db_flush_write appends the collected rows in one transaction and then stamps the live messages. If the write fails, the new messages remain eligible for retry.

entries.behavior: Dispatch a model function call through tool middleware, hook checks, registry lookup, execution, and result hooks.
observed: handle_function_call checks pre-tool hooks before invoking the registry. A plugin can block the call or replace the arguments. Result hooks can transform the final result after tool execution.
